nodes.name: thm:join_paths_to_cycle_main
nodes.statement: For any $\ensuremath{\varepsilon}, K >0$ there exist $\delta, C > 0$ such that, if $p \geq \frac{C}{n}$, then the random graph $G \sim G(n,p)$ satisfies the following with probability $1 - o(n^{-3})$.\ Let $V \subseteq V(G)$ be a vertex set of size at least $\varepsilon n$ and $H$ be a $\left(\frac{1}{2} + \ensuremath{\varepsilon}\right)$-residual spanning subgraph of $G[V]$. Let $\mathcal{M}$ be a matching on $V$ of size at most $\frac{K n}{\log{n}}$ such that $H$ contains a spanning $\mathcal{M}$-respecting $2$-expander with at most $\delta p n^2$ edges. Then there is a Hamilton cycle in $H + \mathcal{M}$ that contains all edges of $\mathcal{M}$.

nodes.name: lem:find-sparse-helper-for-expander
nodes.statement: For each $\ensuremath{\varepsilon}, K > 0$ there exist $\delta, C > 0$ such that, if $p \geq \frac{C}{n}$, then $G \sim G(n, p)$ has the following property with probability $1 - o(n^{-3})$. For every set $V \subseteq V(G)$ of size $|V| \geq \ensuremath{\varepsilon} n$, every matching $\mathcal{M}$ on $V$ of size at most $\frac{K n}{\log{n}}$, every spanning subgraph $H_0$ of $G[V]$ that is an $\mathcal{M}$-respecting $2$-expander with $e(H_0) \leq 2\delta pn^2$, and every $(\frac{1}{2} + \ensuremath{\varepsilon})$-residual spanning subgraph $H$ of $G[V]$, there is some graph $H' \subseteq H - H_0$ with $e(H') \leq 2\delta pn^2$ such that $H_0$ has $\left(\frac{\ensuremath{\varepsilon}}{16}\right)$-many $\mathcal{M}$-respecting boosters with help from $H'$.

nodes.name: lem:many-boosters-in-residual
nodes.statement: For every $\ensuremath{\varepsilon}, K > 0$, there exist $\delta, C > 0$ such that, if $p \geq \frac{C}{n}$, then $G \sim G(n, p)$ has the following property with probability $1 - o(n^{-3})$. For every set $V \subseteq V(G)$ of size $|V|\ge \ensuremath{\varepsilon} n$, every matching $\mathcal{M}$ on $V$ of size at most $\frac{K n}{\log{n}}$, every pair $H_0, H'$ of edge-disjoint spanning subgraphs of $G[V]$ such that $e(H_0), e(H') \leq 2\delta pn^2$ and $H_0$ has $\ensuremath{\varepsilon}$-many $\mathcal{M}$-respecting boosters with help from $H'$, and every $\frac{1}{2}$-residual spanning subgraph $H$ of $G[V]$, there exist edges $e_1, e_2 \in E(H) \cup E(H')$ such that $\{e_1, e_2\}$ is an $\mathcal{M}$-respecting booster for $H_0$.

nodes.name: lem:find-linear-v-linear-u-many-e-boost
nodes.statement: For every $ \ensuremath{\varepsilon}, K > 0$ there exist $\delta, C > 0$ such that, if $p \geq \frac{C}{n}$, then $G \sim G(n, p)$ has the following property with probability $1 - o(n^{-3})$. For every set $V \subseteq V(G)$ of size $|V| \geq \ensuremath{\varepsilon} n$, every matching $\mathcal{M}$ on $V$ of size at most $\frac{K n}{\log{n}}$, every spanning subgraph $H_0$ of $G[V]$ that is an $\mathcal{M}$-respecting $2$-expander graph with at most $2\delta p n^2$ edges, and every $(\frac{1}{2} + \ensuremath{\varepsilon})$-residual spanning subgraph $H$ of $G[V]$, the following happens. For at least $\frac{|V|}{8}$ vertices $v \in V$, there is some set $U_v \subseteq V$ of size $|U_v| \geq \left(\frac{1}{2} + \frac{\ensuremath{\varepsilon}}{8}\right)|V|$ and disjoint subset  $E_{v, u} \subseteq E(H - H_0)$, for $u\in U_v$, of size $|E_{v, u}| \geq \frac{50}{\ensuremath{\varepsilon} \delta}$ such that, for each $u \in U_v$ and $e \in E_{v, u}$, $\{uv, e\}$ is an $\mathcal{M}$-respecting booster for $H_0$.

nodes.name: lem:posa-expander: P 'osa rotation
nodes.statement:
Let $H$ be a graph, and let $\mathcal{M}$ be a matching on $V(H)$. Assume that $H$ is
  an $\mathcal{M}$-respecting $2$-expander graph. Let $P$ be a longest $\mathcal{M}$-respecting path in $H + \mathcal{M}$ which has $v$ as an endpoint. Then, there are at least $\frac{|V(H)|}{8}$ vertices $u \in V(P)$ for which there is an $\mathcal{M}$-respecting $vu$-path in $H + \mathcal{M}$ with vertex set $V(P)$.
